mail_review.situation: 圣彼得堡 TH Faraday Electronics（自有 FARADAY 牌 DIN 电源 + 工业交换机，走俄罗斯安防/自动化分销）。执行董事 Alexander Rudnev 2023-12 → 2025-01 共 16 封实质来信，需求从头到尾只有一条：**DIN 导轨 8 口千兆 PoE（30W+/口）L3 管理 + PoE 看门狗 + SFP/RJ45 上联，1G 够用**；两次被价格顶回（L2 管理 $135「price is really high. We have a supplier with much better prices」；Marvell L3 $350「350USD?」），现供应商用 Realtek。2025-01-03 最后一句「your prices are too high」，此后 Simon 只有群发，无回应。
mail_review.need: 8×GE PoE（≥30W/口）+ 上联 SFP/RJ45、DIN 导轨、管理型（他说 L3，实际用途 CCTV/自动化，L2+ 静态路由大概率够）、PoE 看门狗；价格要贴近 Realtek 方案；要 EXW 人民币价（2024-12-12「Send full datasheet, pls. And EXW price in RMB」）→ 走货代人民币结算。
mail_review.breakpoint: Simon 2024 年只报了 6 系列（Marvell）：STI-288DGGPM 级 $135 和 L3 $350，对方要的是「可靠、够用、价格合理」而不是高端；**Saga 价格主表里其实有 3 系列 STI-288GPM（8 PoE + 2 SFP，管理型，CNY 440）**，当时没推。另：他 2024-05-21 说 10 月想来看厂（「visit your factory in the October」），没有后续安排。

saga_now.price: $85.5 USD EXW（CNY 440 ×1.30 ÷6.69，2026-10-17 快照；Saga 列表价 $88）；按他要求同时给 RMB EXW ≈ ¥572（含 30%）
saga_now.why: 他要 FARADAY 贴牌（OEM 30% 档）且卡价格：3 系列比 6 系列便宜 40%（$85 vs $140），终于落在「reasonable price」区间；L3 需求先用 L2+ 静态路由 + 看门狗回答，真要动态路由再升 STI-488XGGPM $178.8
gaps: STI-288GPM 是否带 PoE 看门狗、每口 30W、L2+ 静态路由——发报价前向 SmartByte 核 LT-IS3210GP-2GX8T 规格书（Drive 已入库，`data/smartbyte_drive/`）

draft_en.subject: 8-port DIN-rail managed PoE switch at a Realtek-level price - FARADAY branding
draft_en.body:
Hi Alexander,

Last time we spoke you were clear: 8 x Gigabit PoE (30 W+ per port), SFP/RJ45 uplinks, managed, PoE watchdog, DIN-rail - and a price that makes sense next to your Realtek supplier. What I quoted then was our high-end 6-series; this is the 3-series that fits your brief:

STI-288GPM - 8 x 10/100/1000 PoE+ (30 W/port) + 2 x 1G SFP, L2+ managed (Web/CLI/SNMP, VLAN, ERPS ring, static routes), PoE watchdog, DC 44-57 V, -40~75 C, DIN-rail. EXW price about RMB 570 / USD 85 per unit with FARADAY front-panel branding included (snapshot 2026-10-22, valid 15 days).

One question: is this price within the range your current Realtek supplier gives you?

Best regards,
Simon
Saga Telecom - PoE / industrial switch OEM-ODM supplier (neutral packing available)
https://sagatele.com/
